description: A server-side route handler for a dashboard page in a SvelteKit project, migrating from Prisma to Django REST API for data fetching and transformation of dashboard-related data (leads, opportunities, activities, tasks, etc.).

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronous function that fetches dashboard data from the API, processes and transforms it into a format suitable for rendering on the dashboard, including metrics, recent leads, opportunities, tasks, activities, and additional dashboard insights.
